def transform(x):
    n = len(x)
    return [x[n - 1 - i] if i % 2 == 0 else x[i] for i in range(n)]

def transform(x):
    n = len(x)
    y = [None] * n
    if n % 2 == 0:                     # even length → make a palindrome
        half = n // 2
        for i in range(half):
            # even i → take element from the far end,
            # odd i  → keep the element from the near end.
            val = x[n - 1 - i] if i % 2 == 0 else x[i]
            y[i] = val
            y[n - 1 - i] = val
    else:                              # odd length → swap symmetric pairs on even positions
        half = n // 2
        for i in range(half):
            if i % 2 == 0:             # even i → swap the pair
                y[i] = x[n - 1 - i]
                y[n - 1 - i] = x[i]
            else:                      # odd i → leave the pair unchanged
                y[i] = x[i]
                y[n - 1 - i] = x[n - 1 - i]
        y[half] = x[half]              # middle element stays the same
    return y
